relations.description: UL Information Transfer procedure involves sending ULInformationTransfer message.
ULInformationTransfer message may contain dedicatedInfoF1c IE.
Condition where AS security is not started guards the property of informing upper layers about delivery failure.
Condition of radio link failure guards the property of informing upper layers about delivery failure.
Condition of PDCP re-establishment or release/addition guards the property of informing upper layers about delivery failure.
Property of informing upper layers is guarded by whether messages only include dedicatedInfoF1c.
UL Information Transfer procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
